game_title: Modulo Gate – Crater Lake Edge Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Crater Lake Edge open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: In Crater Lake Edge, repeat each round: Use % to decide which gates in Crater Lake Edge open (even, odd, divisible by 3). Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the gates_open value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the smelter using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the smelter is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Modulo Gate
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Crater Lake Edge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gates_open changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Crater Lake Edge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The smelter reached with actions_used <= 17.
